cases.input: Process P and capability C transfer accountability from U1 to U2.
cases.expect: R1 closes and successor R2 opens while C and P retain identity.

cases.input: Two teams realize different shares of one capability.
cases.expect: Separate bindings record share, basis, interval and accountability.

cases.input: A system supports a capability alongside an accountable operations team.
cases.expect: System and team bindings remain distinct and coverage is evidence-based.

cases.input: Changing accountable unit rewrites the existing realization.
A system-only binding is labelled full realization.
No realization row is treated as zero coverage.
cases.expect: The collapse is rejected without completeness evidence.
